subject.title: fix: approval prompt misleading text for one-shot commands

question: Should this PR be repaired as the canonical fix for the redirected-command Allow Always wording bug, or should maintainers choose one of the better-proven sibling PRs?
rationale: Multiple open contributor PRs target the same root cause, and this branch has a concrete production-plumbing gap plus a missing real-behavior-proof gate.

options.title: Repair this PR first
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author threads the reason through the real exec host/request and renderer paths, syncs i18n, and adds real prompt proof.

options.title: Promote a sibling PR
options.body: Use another open proof-positive branch as canonical, then close this PR only after that replacement lands or is explicitly selected.

options.title: Pause duplicate branches
options.body: Hold this and sibling branches until an approval-area owner chooses the final implementation shape.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author threads the reason through the real exec host/request and renderer paths, syncs i18n, and adds real prompt proof.
